gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sarala: Loud and slightly goofy, Happy Monkey draws every line like it was cut with a ruler. And Sarala, a friendly sans-serif with distinct gaps in its letters, handles the quieter job of being easy to follow.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wiry, bold lettering up top, then something quieter. Happy Monkey has the weight of drawn wire, while Sawarabi Gothic stays open on every curve, and it reads best when you give it a bit more size.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shanti: Shanti reads modern and unfussy, with a generous opening into the e that keeps each word easy to take in. Happy Monkey, with no calligraphic shading, is made for big, short lines.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shippori-antique: Happy Monkey is all ruler-straight strokes and wide gaps in the e, bold and a little cheeky. Shippori Antique follows with a monoweight skeleton and open bowls, so a long page of text keeps moving smoothly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shippori-antique-: Those ruler-straight strokes give Happy Monkey its whole personality. Shippori Antique B1 is a sans-serif with daylight through every curve, and its steady, modern openness is the strongest thing the pair has going.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sn-pro: Happy Monkey draws its bowls at stem thickness, which gives the heading a bold, signage-like punch. SN Pro is the plain sans that does the opposite job, keeping its curves open so text moves along quietly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-snippet: Snippet reads friendly and capable, its wide-open c looking bent from wire across the whole word. Happy Monkey is the one for loud display lines; Snippet handles the sentences in between.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sour-gummy: Bold and distinctive, Happy Monkey makes its horizontals as thick as its verticals, which gives headings a punchy, stamped look. But Sour Gummy is the sans built for the small stuff, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-source-sans-3: Happy Monkey cuts its stems and curves from one gauge of tubing, which makes every heading feel bold and slightly toy-like. Source Sans 3 keeps a plain sans reading easy, its a opening up to breathe.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-spinnaker: Bold and distinctive up top, with no pinching at the curves. Happy Monkey brings the punch, while Spinnaker keeps its apertures open so the body text stays connected to the space around it.
